title: Auditor Routing Config
description: Declarative routing rules for review-code auditor selection. Precedence: critical_paths > always_on > tag_map > skip.

auditors.description: Registry of all auditors with their weight for scoring.

weight.description: Relative weight used in coverage and pass_rate calculations.

always_on.description: Auditors active on every diff regardless of file types.

tag_map.description: Maps file-path glob patterns to the auditors they activate. All matching globs contribute (union semantics). Glob must be repo-relative (no leading /).

critical_paths.description: Glob patterns that force-activate ALL auditors when matched. Takes precedence over always_on and tag_map. No absolute paths allowed.
